sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Curses for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
-Applies Aquatic Pain to the enemy field for 120 seconds. (Boosts water Unison damage taken by 30%. Reduces ATK by 30%.)
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8500
